sections.h1: The slow report is usually a database problem
lead: When month-end drags or a batch job overruns, the application gets the blame. Most of the time the cause sits lower down, in the database, and nobody is assigned to look.

p: Installation, patching, user and storage management, and routine health checks, run to a written schedule.
We trace slow queries and batch jobs to their cause, then change indexes, statistics, parameters or SQL, and measure before and after.
Backup design, restore testing and recovery procedures that have actually been rehearsed.
Replication, standby and failover set-ups matched to the recovery time and data loss your business can accept.
Moves between versions, platforms and clouds, including Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, with a tested fallback.
DBA support from our delivery centres under an agreed service level, as a managed service or as extra hands for your team.
Capture current performance, capacity, backup state and open risks.
Fix what is unsafe first: failed backups, missing patches, single points of failure.
Work through the slowest and most business-critical workloads and record each change.
Monitoring, alerting and regular reporting under the service level you choose.
A recurring review of capacity, cost and risk so problems surface before users find them.
Where the slowness comes from application design or undersized hardware, database work will only get you part of the way. We say so, and point to the real fix.

a: Our published work is centred on Oracle, including Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. Tell us what else you run and we will say plainly whether we have the depth for it.

faq.q: Can you work alongside our own DBAs?
a: Yes. Some clients use us for out-of-hours cover or for a specific project, and keep day-to-day administration in house.

faq.q: How do you prove a tuning change worked?
a: We record the same measurements before and after the change, on the same workload, and share them.
Support hours are set in the service level. Round-the-clock cover is possible because we work from Dubai, London, Islamabad and Singapore.
